name: Video
description: Georeferenced video overlay (.webm/.mp4) draped onto a bounding box on the 2D map.

supportedData.label: Web video
supportedData.description: A video file overlaid on the map within a configured bounding box. Supports autoplay and looping; always muted by default.
supportedData.procurement: Encode to H.264 .mp4 or VP8/VP9 .webm; provide the geographic bounding box the frame covers.
